decision_rule: The boundary ratio at the final checkpoint (step143000) must reach 0.3. The bar is absolute, with no baseline correction, because the smaller sibling's untrained checkpoint read -0.080316 there, which is effectively zero. Below 0.3 the reading is BOUNDARY_NOT_FORMED_BY_FINAL, which contradicts the same checkpoint's committed 0.514227 and is therefore an instrument fault; the gate cell tests the same number first, so a passing gate makes this reading unreachable.
metric: Boundary ratio at the final checkpoint: mean of the first two profile parts minus mean of the last two.
notes: The boundary ratio is the mean of the profile's first two parts minus the mean of its last two. Its bar stays absolute at 0.3, with no baseline correction, because the smaller sibling's untrained checkpoint read -0.080316, which is effectively zero. On that sibling's final checkpoint the ratio reads -0.090673, so the boundary is absent at 410 million weights and present at 1.4 billion. That is why this formation sweep runs on the larger model. Recorded beside it, and gating nothing: the corpus's dominant hard-wrap length is about 70 to 72 characters, which is where the second profile part ends. If either integrity gate recorded in these values failed, this record is void as evidence about the model, and is an instrument fault only. A further run of this script on the same box is a rerun of the same instrument, not a replication.
